PERMAGN.summary: Intimation under. Quantum Magnetics Private Limited (QMPL), a wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, is scheduled to inaugurate its NdFeB Permanent Magnet Manufacturing Facility at Vasai, Maharashtra on December 08, 2026. The facility will support the manufacturing of NdFeB Permanent Magnets, which are used in electric vehicles, renewable energy, electronics and other industrial applications.
